newsitem.title: ISRAEL: HOT STOCKS - Israel's Elite up 7.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: HOT STOCKS - Israel's Elite up 7.0 pct.

text.p: Elite Industries Ltd shares were up 7.0 percent in heavy volume but traders said there was no specific reason for the rise and the company said it was not planning any announcement.
The shares were trading at 1,143 points in unusually high volume of 1.8 million shekels.
"It's very impressive. There is something there," said Eli Nahum, head of trading at Zannex Securities.
He said the activity could be linked to the company's plans for restructuring of its problematic European operations.
"Everyone is waiting to see how the restructuring of their international operations will go. Once they announce they are doing it, we will see it reflected in the share price," Nahum said.
He said the share is currently undervalued and he believes in the next 12 months -- once the restructuring is in place -- the shares should rise to 1,700 to 1,800.
A company spokeswoman said she knew of no reason for the activity in Elite shares. Other traders also said they had not heard of any news.
